audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two bullet bodies were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.why: The decisive interaction is that Death Lotus is a channel — any hard CC cancels it, and Command: Shockwave is exactly that. Shunpo is 725 range and blinks to daggers as well as to champions, so clearing dagger ground matters as much as watching her. Voracity refunds her cooldowns on any nearby takedown. Death Lotus also applies healing reduction while it channels.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Shunpo 12s/8s, Death Lotus 75s, Bouncing Blade 11s, your E 9s and R 110s, and the channel-interrupt is stated outright.
All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames are false positives: "Hold Shockwave" is Orianna's own R (Command: Shockwave) and "Ult Death Lotus" is Katarina's real R name. Neither is a fabricated ability, so neither field was touched.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives and were left alone: "Hold Shockwave" refers to Orianna's own Command: Shockwave, and "Ult Death Lotus" is Katarina's real ultimate. Chart rows 0, 1, 2, 4 and 5 moved the full layer onto the content layer, which already agreed with packet.levelChart — win[N] therefore already holds the correct values and no paired content edit exists to propose. Rows 3 and 6 already agreed and were not moved. The kit file's derived flags put "grounding" on Bouncing Blade, but Riot's own description for that ability says only that the dagger bounces and lands on the ground — no grounding effect. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing about grounding. report[8].t here also carries the stray "the moment Zed hits 6" line seen on the other Orianna pages; left under the two-report cap.
